pr_body:
## Summary

Replays the validated ADR0126 Timeline core, shared authoring contracts, CLI/MCP capability adapters, and transient Game View camera override onto the latest current main after unrelated Editor/AI Studio work merged. The structured edits were re-evaluated against current main through the canonical producer/Dispatcher path.

This fresh task branch supersedes Draft PR #285 after the replay and schema correction are both validated. Keep this PR Draft and unmerged while the remaining ADR0126 first-release runtime, Project Rust, packaged-player, Sequencer, and visual-validation requirements are completed.
